channel.title: GitHub Trending, Minus the AI
channel.description: A non-AI view of GitHub Trending — a daily digest of open-source tools, libraries, languages, and projects trending right now.

item.title: GitHub Trending, Minus the AI — November 8, 2026
item.description:
Today's 49 trending open-source repositories, with AI-focused projects filtered out. Highlights:

  1. public-apis/public-apis (497,161 ⭐) — A collective list of free APIs
  2. freeCodeCamp/freeCodeCamp (458,742 ⭐) — freeCodeCamp.org's open-source codebase and curriculum. Learn math, programming, and computer science for free.
  3. EbookFoundation/free-programming-books (401,262 ⭐) — :books: Freely available programming books
  4. nilbuild/developer-roadmap (371,527 ⭐) — Interactive roadmaps, guides and other educational content to help developers grow in their careers.
  5. jwasham/coding-interview-university (364,086 ⭐) — A complete computer science study plan to become a software engineer.
  6. awesome-selfhosted/awesome-selfhosted (334,986 ⭐) — A list of Free Software network services and web applications which can be hosted on your own servers
  7. vinta/awesome-python (333,319 ⭐) — The definitive list that answers "I want to do X in Python, which tool should I use?"
  8. practical-tutorials/project-based-learning (289,323 ⭐) — Curated list of project-based tutorials
  9. torvalds/linux (254,838 ⭐) — Linux kernel source tree
  10. react/react (252,404 ⭐) — The library for web and native user interfaces.
